segments.name: Medicines for serious diseases
segments.description: Discovers, develops, manufactures, and commercializes medicines for serious diseases including eye, allergic, inflammatory, cancer, cardiovascular, metabolic, neurological, hematologic, and infectious diseases.
segments.evidence: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a fully integrated biotechnology company that invents, develops, manufactures, and commercializes medicines for people with serious diseases.

revenueModel.text: Patients and healthcare providers purchase medicines for treating serious diseases, with reimbursement from third-party payors, insurance programs, and government healthcare programs.
revenueModel.evidence: The availability and extent of reimbursement or copay assistance for Regeneron's Products from third-party payors and other third parties, including private payor healthcare and insurance programs, health maintenance organizations, pharmacy benefit management companies, and government programs such as Medicare and Medicaid
